name: Lume Coral
description: Branching coral with pale branches and glowing violet tips, three trunks on a stone base. About 2.9 m tall; the bioluminescent dressing of the luminous deep.

name: Glass Sponge Colony
description: Seven flared bone-white sponge tubes (0.8-2.4 m) with softly glowing mouths and ring ribs, on a stone base.

name: Lamp Stalks
description: Nine slender bent stalks (1.6-3.8 m) each tipped with a glowing bulb, violet or amber: a soft light grove for dark basins.

name: Whale Fall
description: A whale skeleton lying on the seabed, about 15 m long: spine, eight rib pairs, skull and jaw, with violet bacterial mats glowing around the bones. A landmark.

name: Tubeworm Garden
description: Sixteen white tubeworm tubes (0.9-2.6 m) tipped with orange-red plumes, on a rock mound: scenery version of the Tubeworm Spitter enemy.

name: Manganese Nodule Field
description: A patch of dark nodules, 26 loose and five cyan crystal glints, about 4.8 m across: a resource-gathering spot or seabed dressing.

name: Sunken Street Lamp
description: A leaning iron lamp post 5.2 m tall with a curved arm and an amber lantern that still glows. Street dressing for the sunken city.

name: Record Obelisk
description: A stepped stone obelisk 8 m tall with ten rows of glowing glyph bars on the front and a ring at mid height. Looks like a recording device; its meaning is left open.

name: Dwelling Ruin Corner
description: A collapsed house corner 6.4 m wide: walls of uneven height, an arched doorway, a window with an amber lamp and scattered blocks.

name: Everyday Ware Set
description: Two urns, a bowl, a plate, a cup and a ladle: everyday objects one urn of which has a glowing rim. A fun prop the hermit crab can mistake for tools.

name: Conduit Bundle
description: Five iron pipes of different widths bundled by three clamps along 7 m, glowing seams at each end and a bend with an amber lamp.

name: Mural Panel
description: A framed stone panel 4.8 m wide and 3.8 m tall with concentric ring reliefs, amber spirals and a row of five glowing circles. The meaning of the pictures is left open.

name: Glowing Rubble
description: A heap of fourteen fallen blocks about 4 m across, with amber light leaking from its cracks.

name: Afterimage Echo
description: Four translucent copies of a diamond body, spaced 1.7 m apart and fading backwards, each with a violet ring and a tiny eye. Visual for the lingering-presence phenomenon.

name: Phase Rift
description: A tall oval rift 5.3 m high: glowing double frame, a translucent wobbling face and ten glowing shards. Visual for places overlapping.

name: Rainbow Current
description: Five translucent ribbons (red, yellow, green, cyan, violet) twisting 1.6 turns up a 12 m column and widening as they rise. Visual for the final-depth rainbow current.

name: Floating Stones
description: Nine stones drifting at 1-6 m in a loose ring, violet underlight on each and thin translucent threads linking them. Visual for the weight-drift phenomenon.

name: Pressure Husk Dome
description: A translucent dome 8 m wide and 3.2 m high (its lower half lies below the ground plane) with a glowing rim and three violet shell lines. Visual for an area that keeps an earlier pressure.

name: Unseen Steps
description: Six faint translucent slabs (1.6 x 1.1 m) spiralling up 4.5 m, only their edges glowing. Visual for the invisible-footing phenomenon.

name: Abyssal Monolith
description: A light-swallowing black pillar 12.8 m tall on two steps, with one thin glowing seam and a floating ring with three violet beads. Its meaning is left open.
